name: SikaFiber Force PP-48 / RAD-48s
paste:
SIKAFIBER® FORCE PP-48 / RAD-48S: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaFiber® Force PP-48 / RAD-48s, March 2026, Version 01.05 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/sikafiber_force_pp-48rad-48s.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaFiber® Force PP-48 / RAD-48s where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2026, Version 01.05).
1.2 Product description. SikaFiber® Force PP-48 / RAD-48s is a macro structural synthetic fiber that delivers optimum performance in highly corrosive environments. It is suited in pre-cast, slabs on ground among many other applications. Higher Re3 values (equivalent flexural strength ratio based on ASTM C1609 testing) are achieved in slabs on grade when using this fiber.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Fibrecrete/shotcrete
    - Ground supported slabs
    - Precast elements
    - Industrial flooring
    - Sea defense
    - Airport & pavements
    - Slope stabilization
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaFiber® Force PP-48 / RAD-48s
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Polyolefin macro-synthetic fibers for shotcrete and concrete
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. SikaFiber® Force PP-48 / RAD-48s complies with ASTM C1116 Type III and EN 14889-2: 2006, class 2.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ASTM C1609: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Description (p.1).
    - EN 14889-2: 2006: listed under approvals, certificates or standards; referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1); Further Documentation > Specification Clause (p.2).
    - ASTM C1116: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - ASTM C1550: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Application Information > Recommended dosage (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Non-magnetic, rustproof and alkali proof
    - Less balling effect in difficult mixes
    - No site waste or disposal issues.
    - Saves time and storage space in comparison to traditional mesh
    - Uniquely designed and packaged allowing it to be evenly dispersed ensuring no balling or pumping problems will occur.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polyolefin polymer
    - Density: 0.91 g/cm³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Dimensions: Fiber length 48 mm; Mean Width 1.37 mm; Mean Thickness 0.34 mm
    - Melting point: 170°C
    - Tensile strength: characteristic value: 550 MPa
    - Resistance to alkalinity: Excellent
    - Water absorption: Nil
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: NA
    - Storage conditions: Store protected from the weather.
2.8 Packaging. 5 Kg boxes- fibers wrapped in water soluble plastic pucks (Parallel Packed) in biodegradable boxes. Entire package can be thrown into the mix allowing for easy handling whilst leaving no waste on site. Environment friendly recycled packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2026, Version 01.05) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2026, Version 01.05) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: 4-8 kg/m³; RDPs typical test results; Energy absorption 450+ Joules (as per ASTM C1550, @ 6 kg/m³)
    - Compatibility: SikaFiber® Force PP-48 / RAD-48s macro-synthetic fibres are compatible with all concrete admixtures and performance enhancing chemicals.
4.3 Dispensing. SikaFiber® Force PP 48 is uniquely designed and packaged allowing it to be evenly dispersed through the matrix, insuring no balling or pumping problems will occur. Can be added to the mix at any stage during batching. Allow 5 minutes at mixing speed for fibers to disperse evenly throughout matrix.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations. The addition of SikaFiber® Force PP 48 can cause a reduction in the concrete workability. We recommend correcting this loss not by adding more water, but by adjusting the mix to the required consistency with a suitable dosage of a Sika® ViscoCrete® or SikaPlast® admixture.
4.5 Further documentation - Specification Clause. Fibres for concrete shall be SikaFiber® Force PP 48 polyolefin high performance macro-synthetic fibre conforming to EN 14889-2: 2006 Class 2 and manufactured specifically for the reinforcement of concrete. SikaFiber® Force PP 48 macro-synthetic fibres shall be mixed at the batch plant, at the recommended rate of 4-8 kg per cubic metre, and mixed for sufficient time (minimum 5 minutes) to ensure uniform distribution of the fibres throughout the concrete mix.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2026, Version 01.05) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaFiber® Force PP-48 / RAD-48s, March 2026, Version 01.05, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/sikafiber_force_pp-48rad-48s.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaFiber® Force PP-48 / RAD48s, version 30/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sds-sikafiber-forcepp-48rad48s.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaFiber® PP, version 19/07/2024, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/n/SikaFiber%20PP%20SDS.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Polypropylene-based macro and blended fibres, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/epd-polypropylene-basedmacroandblendedfibres.pdf
    - Brochure: Sika Fibre Solutions 2026 v1, version 05/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/Sika%20Fibre%20-%20A4%202025%20FIN%20DIGI.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
